aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (Linear/Vercel dark neutral + electric accent) crossed with Terminal/hacker theming — dark-only code-editor palette, keyboard-command surface, one electric-red brand accent over a near-black blueprint ground

psychology: Hick's Law / Jakob's Law — the keyboard command rail keeps option density for expert SCANNING (not a decision point); correct use of richness for a power-user workspace rather than a choice-overload violation
Von Restorff — a single blue primary (OK/Accept/Join) pops against the dark neutral ground; one prominent action per view is held
Fitts's Law — whole event blocks are large drag/click targets and keyboard shortcuts cut kinematic load
Zeigarnik / loss-framing — menu-bar 'ends in 42m' countdown exploits time-to-next-meeting urgency (honest, real deadline)
Miller/Cowan chunking — right rail grouped into NAVIGATION/VIEWS/ACTIONS chunks; processing-fluency helped by consistent dark theming

Aesthetic-Usability — coherent, disciplined dark system buys first-contact trust; slight cost: uppercase headers + keycap noise raise extraneous load for non-power users (acceptable for the stated audience)
